name: YouTube

disclosure.zh: YouTube 只通过官方 YouTube Data API 发布（Google 不允许在内置浏览器里登录）。发布表单里如实勾选「加工或合成的内容」（逼真的 AI 生成/修改内容必须披露），并选择「是否为儿童打造」。未通过 API 审核的项目上传会被锁成私享。
disclosure.en: YouTube is published only through the official YouTube Data API (Google refuses sign-in in embedded browsers). In the publish form, tick "Altered or synthetic content" when realistic content was made or changed with AI, and answer "Made for kids". Uploads from a project that has not passed the API audit stay private.

notes: Not used for filling: YouTube goes through the official Data API (src/main/publish/api/youtube.ts). The selectors stay for page captures only.
Thumbnail upload needs a verified channel (phone verification); otherwise the cover input is missing and the step is reported not-found.
Tags are appended to the description as #hashtags (the first 3 show above the title).

guide.zh: 一个频道两种格式：长视频（16:9）和 Shorts（竖屏或方形、≤ 3 分钟）。左边选要发的那条，应用放入视频、填好标题和说明；「是否为儿童打造」「加工或合成的内容」由你选，再点「发布 / 保存」。Shorts 的说明里链接点不开。
guide.en: One channel, two formats: long-form (16:9) and Shorts (vertical or square, <= 3 min). Pick the post on the left; the app adds the video and types the title and description. Set Made for kids and Altered content yourself, then press Publish / Save. Links in Shorts descriptions are not clickable.
